joinIonConsent:
𝗠𝗼𝘇𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗮 𝗜𝗼𝗻 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗮𝗰𝘆 𝗡𝗼𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗲

October 30, 2020

Ion is an experimental initiative led by Mozilla to better understand how our users use and navigate the internet. Ion is available to Firefox desktop users in the United States who are 19 or older. In this Privacy Notice, we detail what data the Ion program collects and discloses, and why.

When you join Mozilla Ion, we’ll collect basic technical and interaction data as long as you’re participating in the program. Once you’ve enrolled, you’ll also have the opportunity to join available studies—each study will have a specific research purpose and a unique privacy notice for you to review before you join it.

Read each study’s privacy notice for information about how data is collected and handled in that particular study. We also adhere to the Mozilla Privacy Policy (https://www.mozilla.org/privacy/) for how we receive, handle, and share information.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗜𝗻𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗪𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗰𝘁:

𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗮: We collect information about your device’s operating system and your version of Firefox. When Firefox sends data to us, your IP address is also temporarily collected as part of our server logs.

𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗮: We collect data about your interactions with Firefox, like number and type of installed Firefox Add-ons and how much time you use Firefox.

𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗮: We will use your IP address to approximate your country, state, and city location.

To see a full list of the data we collect, click here (https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/mozilla-ion-managing-account-data?as=u&utm_source=inproduct).

𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗪𝗲 𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗜𝗻𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

We use the information we collect for for research and development, including:
  To ensure our data sets are representative of the many users of Firefox
  To improve our existing products and services
  To create and develop new products

𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝗪𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝘆 𝗗𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗹𝗼𝘀𝗲 𝗜𝗻𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗧𝗼:

𝗚𝗼𝗼𝗴𝗹𝗲 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺 (𝗚𝗖𝗣): We use GCP as our cloud-storage service. Mozilla has contracted with GCP requiring them to store the data only, and to do so in ways that are approved by us.

𝗧𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗱-𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝘆 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗿𝘀: As part of being part of the Ion program, we will offer you the ability to join studies. If necessary for the study, we may ask you to share all or some of the data collected under this Privacy Notice with the third party researcher(s) administering the study. Read each study’s unique privacy notice for information about how data is collected and handled in that particular study.

𝗚𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗽𝘂𝗯𝗹𝗶𝗰: To advance our mission of being open, we may release data sets to the general public. When we do so, we will aggregate the data and remove identifying information, so the data won’t reveal the behaviors or characteristics of individual users.

𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: You can learn more about managing your Ion and individual study data here (https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/mozilla-ion-managing-account-data?as=u&utm_source=inproduct).

If you have any other questions regarding our privacy practices, please contact us at compliance@mozilla.com.
